verdict.rationale: Fireworks is an API/inference platform accessed via HTTP (api.fireworks.ai) with OpenAI-compatible endpoints, batch inference, and firectl CLI commands (e.g. deployment create), which are inherently usable headlessly/in CI without any interactive UI. However, there is no explicit CI/CD example, GitHub Actions integration, or documented automation pipeline in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, GitHub Actions or automation-platform integration docs, evidence of headless auth/token setup for CI environments.
